story: Stage 4 was shortened to 130.8 km after extreme fire danger forced organisers to cancel the Willunga Hill ascents. Greenwood attacked early, later joined by Plapp and Cavagna before the move was caught. Nr 2 in the GC Narváez crashed out early in the race. Raccagni took the youth GC lead with bonification second, while Ethan Vernon sprinted to victory ahead of Tobias Lund Andresen and Laurence Pithie after strong work from his teammate Brady Gilmore.
